hints.title: Ability Bound
hints.text: The robot can neutralize at most two negative encounters along any path.

hints.title: Three-Dimensional State
hints.text: Define dp[i][j][k] as the maximum profit reaching cell (i, j) having used k neutralizations.

hints.title: Option Evaluation
hints.text: At each cell from top or left, evaluate either accepting the value or setting negative coins to 0 if k > 0.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Grid DP with 3 neutralization states per cell.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(m * n * 3) DP table maintains state counts.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Augments grid DP with an extra dimension tracking neutralization charges.
